text:
noah (acct exec): Heads-up — LumenPath asking for a short pilot discount. They want a 4-week proof with 75% off hosted inference rates to validate our HL7 adapter + usage spikes. Can we shortcut approval? :eyes:
aria (finance ops): 75% is steep. What's the pilot size and commercial ask after pilot? Need $ numbers and conversion signal.
noah (acct exec): Pilot estimate: ~1.2M tokens total over 4 weeks. List pricing ~ $0.025/token, so list = ~$30k. With 75% off they'd pay ~$7.5k. Sales argues high strategic value — could convert to a 9-12mo commit (~$120k ARR).
rafael (revops): Recommend treating as marketing concession GL=5401 and setting a hard credit cap. Also prefer prepay or onboarding fee to avoid open-ended exposure. Suggest cap = $8k, onboarding fee = $1,500.
meera (head of finance): We can approve up to 45% off for pilots of this size without VP signoff. For >45% must route to VP. We need 1) deal desk ticket, 2) LOI or signed evaluation terms, 3) SOW limiting scope, and 4) a confirmed GL code.
tara (legal): If PHI/clinical data involved, legal needs the data flow diagram + BAAs in place. Also propose a one-way indemnity carveout for pilot. Will review SOW within 72hrs once submitted.
noah (acct exec): Understood. Sales can accept 45% + $1.5k onboarding + $8k cap to keep within finance limits. I'll ask customer to sign LOI. tagging @dealbot to create ticket.
dealbot: /dealdesk create customer=LumenPath pilot_discount=45% pilot_cap=8000 onboarding_fee=1500 expected_ARR=120000 notes="HL7 adapter, clinical imaging workload"
alice (sales): Adding that customer asks offline for a deeper discount if we include dedicated capacity later. That would be a separate negotiation and needs VP ok.
financebot: Checklist: attach deal desk URL, LOI pdf, SOW, GL code. Finance will finalize concession memo after docs.
meera (head of finance): Once docs uploaded, finance ops will do gross-to-net calc and confirm booking treatment. If legal flags PHI risk, activation is paused until mitigations done.
aria (finance ops): I'll own the concession memo and GL coding. Tagged for follow-up when ticket is live.
noah (acct exec): Thanks all — will upload the LOI and SOW today. Closing loop when done. :thumbsup:
